title: EGO-PRO sample sessions
about: Two tactile gloves, a head camera and two wrist cameras on a tabletop. The folder holds one session for each of 50 tasks (X001–X050); 8 are shown.

hardware.d: 460 raw channels per hand, 370 placed: palm 14×15, finger strips 4×8 · model not named in the files
Head 1920×1080, wrist 1280×960 wide-angle · JPEG on the 60 Hz frame index

hardware.v: 25-joint hand skeletons, head and wrist poses
hardware.d: The provider's Foxglove layout names MANUS and Vive as sources
Chinese captions with English type labels

notes: Shared as a Google Drive folder of annotated MCAP files (schema egopro 4.0) with a Foxglove layout and guide; no license or terms are included. Task names are Chinese in the files; the English titles are the catalog's translation.
